baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative participle مُورِيَات and the manner/result accusative قَدْحًا form a release-by-contact construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A striker does not manufacture fire from nothing; repeated contact makes a hidden capacity take and become visible.

activation_trace.role: Hidden fire emerging from a fire-stick supplies the latent capacity and the causative act of releasing it.
Striking out fire supplies the contact operation and its visible fiery result.

changed_reading.after: Agents repeatedly make concealed fire take through forceful contact.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُورِيَات marks active bringers-forth, while قَدْحًا can name an incision, score, or flaw.
baseline_models.mechanism: Impact opens or marks a surface, and the mark makes an otherwise hidden condition legible.

activation_trace.role: Covering and withdrawal from sight supplies the concealed state that the causative form reverses.
Scoring, splitting, or flawing supplies the revealing breach and the durable mark.

changed_reading.after: The action scores a cover so that a concealed condition flashes into evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus roots carry an idiom of a fire-stick taking successfully and a branch of deliberative undertaking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fire-making construction can model an operation that succeeds because counsel, aid, and decisive examination make it catch.

activation_trace.role: A fire-stick taking as success, counsel, aid, or defense supplies achieved efficacy rather than flame alone.
Considering and planning an affair supplies the deliberate operation through which efficacy is obtained.

changed_reading.after: Capable agents make an undertaking catch through aided, deliberate engagement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus becomes the contact-conversion hinge between sustained rushing and a changed morning state: exertion reaches impact, impact releases latent fire, and the released flash precedes the incursion.

activation_trace.role: Latent fire emerging supplies the conversion product of the surrounding motion.
Striking supplies the contact event that converts motion into sparks.
Extended running supplies sustained kinetic input before the focus impact.
The split mapping's habit and repetition sharpen the running into a practiced recurrent cycle.
Audible panting makes bodily exertion, rather than abstract motion, materially present.
Change of form or substitution frames the spark as a phase transition in the sequence.
First daylight supplies the newly visible temporal field reached after the flash.

structural_cues: 100:1-3 repeat feminine plural participles with terminal accusatives, while فـ places 100:2 between exertion and morning incursion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies running, panting, striking-fire branches, change, and morning; I supply the arrow that bodily motion produces contact-fire which enables the next phase. A live alternative is coordinated tools or agents rather than hooves.

changed_reading.before: Agents produce sparks in an isolated tableau.
changed_reading.after: Practiced rushing is converted at contact into a flash that marks and enables a changed operational phase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spark is no longer the climax; it is the smallest visible threshold in a cascade that dislodges matter, leaves a trace, raises an obscuring medium, penetrates a center, and reconstitutes dispersed force as one body.

activation_trace.role: Emergence of hidden fire supplies the first visible threshold in the cascade.
The strike supplies the initiating impulse.
Moving a thing from its place extends ignition into material displacement.
The split mapping's remaining trace turns the brief spark into a readable sign of what passed.
Raised dust supplies the expanding medium produced after the initial contact.
Entry into the middle supplies directed penetration rather than diffuse commotion.
Parts gathering their strength supplies the coherent collective force reached by the sequence.

structural_cues: The repeated فـ chain in 100:2-5 orders spark, excitation, dust, and penetration as successive effects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, displacement, trace, dust, central entry, and gathered force; I infer one escalating causal system whose threshold is the focus strike. They may instead be consecutive camera frames without strict causation.

changed_reading.before: The sparks are a self-contained display of speed.
changed_reading.after: The sparks are an ignition threshold whose brief flash predicts displacement, obscuration, penetration, and collective concentration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's success-and-aid branch becomes morally reversible: nurtured capacity catches and succeeds, but its use can cut itself from its source, so the visible result becomes a sign testifying to the beneficiary's relation to the giver.

activation_trace.role: The fire-stick that takes through aid or counsel supplies enabled success.
Planning an affair supplies intentional use of the enabled capacity.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supplies the prior enabling relation.
Cutting and separation supply the beneficiary's reversal away from that relation.
Ingratitude for favor identifies the social-moral failure enacted by the cut.
A witnessing sign turns outwardly successful action into evidence of its source-relation.

structural_cues: After the opening oath sequence, 100:6-7 shifts from energetic agents to the human's relation to a nurturing lord and to testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aided success, nurture, severance, ingratitude, and a witnessing mark; I infer that exercised capacity exposes how aid is answered. The opening may remain only an oath-image rather than an enacted moral analogy.

changed_reading.before: The agents' success is simply admired efficacy.
changed_reading.after: Successful ignition is borrowed capacity whose visible use can testify either to received aid or to severance from its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: A second fire valuation appears: not every spark becomes useful flame. Desire bound tightly around supposed good can generate brilliant but sterile emissions, activity that flashes without yielding benefit.

activation_trace.role: Emergent sparks supply the visible energetic output whose value is now questioned.
Repeated striking supplies effort capable of producing flash without durable utility.
Sparks from a small fire that give no benefit directly supplies the sterile-flash counterimage.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the utility criterion the sparks may fail.
A tightened knot supplies desire's constriction around its object.
Severe withholding supplies the social form of energetic acquisition without beneficial release.

structural_cues: 100:8 binds love, claimed good, and intensity in one predication, permitting benefit and intensity to diverge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal non-beneficial sparks, beneficial good, tight binding, and miserliness; I infer a critique of flash without useful yield. The non-beneficial spark branch may be lexical resonance only, not the opening image's valuation.

changed_reading.before: Spark production itself signifies power and success.
changed_reading.after: Spark production can also image desire-driven expenditure that flashes intensely yet withholds useful fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus compresses a disclosure protocol: a covered interior is struck or probed, the cover is overturned, the hidden core or residue is extracted, and the resulting mark becomes knowable as evidence of the source from which actions issue.

activation_trace.role: Covering something out of sight supplies the concealed initial state that مُورِيَات reverses.
Scoring or splitting supplies the invasive opening that makes the interior legible.
Drawing difficult residue from a vessel or well supplies extraction after opening.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies the endpoint of the protocol.
Turning soil and uncovering what is buried supplies forceful reversal of the cover.
Obscurity and depression supply the deeply concealed condition acted upon.
Extracting a kernel or precious content from its casing supplies selective recovery of the interior.
The source from which actions issue locates the concealed interior as behavior's origin.
Knowledge of inward reality confirms that disclosure reaches beneath reportable surface appearance.

structural_cues: The passive overturning and extraction in 100:9-10 move from graves to chests, followed by explicit inward knowledge in 100:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, scoring, drawing residue, overturning burial, extracting a kernel, an inner source, and inward knowledge; I infer a single probe-to-evidence arrow. A live alternative keeps the opening physical and treats the later disclosures as only thematic rhyme.

changed_reading.before: The strike reveals only pre-existing fire.
changed_reading.after: The strike is a miniature disclosure technology: breach, overturn, extract, and render a hidden source evidentially visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rare lot branch of قَدْح and the lordship branch of a holder gathering lots activate a juridical-divinatory overlay: one cast piece is gathered into an accountable outcome whose significance is witnessed and disclosed.

activation_trace.role: The arrow-shaft or gaming lot supplies a cast token whose outcome awaits reading.
A hidden result flashing into visibility supplies the lot's moment of manifestation.
A holder that gathers lots supplies the container and ordering frame for multiple tokens.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies witnessed interpretation of the manifest result.
A thing becoming disclosed to a knower supplies epistemic resolution.
Gathering until the resultant total appears supplies accounting rather than isolated chance.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from an oath containing قَدْح to lordship, testimony, knowing, and the appearance of a collected result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lot, a lordship-root holder of lots, testimony, disclosure, and resultant aggregation; I infer an accountability scene in which a cast token becomes readable. Literal fire remains the dominant alternative, and the surface قَدْحًا need not denote the lot noun.

changed_reading.before: قَدْحًا names only the act that makes fire.
changed_reading.after: It can faintly echo a cast lot whose hidden import flashes forth within a witnessed accounting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers fire-elicitation into cultivation and uses the tender-plant branch of ق د ح rather than the immediate verbal noun; it remains anchored in both focus words as causative emergence plus tender tips and is cross-activated by seed, barrenness, cultivation, and unfirm fruit. Render only as an ecological counterimage, not as the preferred lexical construal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُورِيَات supplies causative emergence from latency, while the focus's ق د ح inventory itself includes tender plant tips.

activation_trace.role: Latent fire brought forth supplies a generalized emergence-from-hiddenness mechanism.
Tender tips and fresh soft leaves supply the fragile emergent object.
Land that does not grow supplies the resistant substrate from which emergence is uncertain.
A seed that grows and bears seed supplies reproductive continuity after emergence.
Dates formed before becoming firm supply an immature later stage of the tender tip.
Cultivating and repairing land supplies the enabling practice that links substrate to growth.

changed_reading.before: The agents elicit sparks from resistant matter.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the agents elicit tender life from a resistant substrate, with emergence valued by whether it matures and reproduces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because both focus branches are somatic or corrosive edge senses, far from the obvious fire collocation; it remains anchored in the illness and decay inventories and gains coherence from chest-interior and separated residue. Downstream prose should label it a dark material analogy of invasive diagnosis, not a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root inventories join an inward-eating illness under و ر ي to decay that bores wood or teeth under ق د ح.

activation_trace.role: Illness eating the belly or lung supplies concealed internal consumption and the possibility of a probing wound.
Decay eating wood or teeth supplies slow corrosion that produces an outwardly discoverable defect.
Residue left after lifting or separation supplies diagnostic remainder.
The bodily chest supplies the interior site in which the corrosive image is localized.

changed_reading.before: The focus shows clean instantaneous ignition.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, it images invasive contact exposing a slow inward corrosion through the defect and residue it leaves.

strongest_changes: The flanking kinetic sequence turns the focus into a contact-conversion hinge rather than an isolated spark image.
The later grave-to-chest sequence strongly reactivates the focus as a breach-extract-disclose protocol.
Aid, nurture, severance, and testimony allow successful ignition to become evidence about how received capacity is used.
The non-beneficial-sparks branch preserves a counterreading in which intensity flashes without yielding useful fire.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus behaves as a reversible hinge: hidden energy becomes fire, hidden condition becomes evidence, aided capacity becomes testimony, and even a brilliant spark can be revalued as sterile. The packet's split roots and rare material branches keep kinetic, epistemic, moral, juridical, ecological, and corrosive readings live without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not identify its agents by itself; hoof, tool, coordinated actor, and analogical process remain open.
Most causal arrows come from the ordered فـ sequence and material compatibility, not from an explicit statement that each stage causes the next.
The lot, ecological, and corrosion readings are branch-grounded but form-distant and should coexist as contained activations, not displace the strong ignition model.
The disclosure reading may be a later-context reactivation of literal fire rather than a second sense operative in the focus at first occurrence.
